label: Cold War Files

szenen.text: A B-52 carrying *four hydrogen bombs* crashed on ice.
A *cabin fire* forced the crew to bail out.
The bombs' *explosives* detonated and spread radioactive material.
Records say parts of only *three bombs* were found.
Where did the fourth one go? What do you think?

caption: A B-52 with four hydrogen bombs crashed in Greenland in 1968. Accounts differ on what was recovered. What do you think happened to the fourth bomb? Send this to someone who doesn't believe it. AI voice & edit. Footage: Pixabay/Pexels.
